form: J17 fracture v1 (account D), cut by the cables builder's copy of the lane's tools, 12.11.2026 03:29
character: State Flex No. 3, issued by the metre: too thin, so a second wire was wound round it; cut once and spliced under two wads of plaster; tagged and stamped by a clerk; a metre too long, looped and taped. It breaks in character: the splice lets go first, the frayed end spits, the tags flutter down last.
units: sprite px of the intact picture, y down; outline = convex hull, points relative to the piece centre; mass = px area x areal density
breakOrder: 1 hung (the splice): the planned weak line: the cord parts under the splice's lower plaster and the lamp falls with the cord below it
2 nailed / tied: the feed wire springs off its staple
3 tied / strapped: the tags and the spare loop come off
4 tied: the knot slips the hook: the whole cord falls
5 hung: any other joint of the flex, when a hit lands on it (every joint is a place it can be cut)
6 hooked: the hook leaves the plate only with the plate

notes: The flex is one verlet strip (`flap.strip` = flex), as the laundry's cloth strips: points at the segment joints, the bitmap skinned along it, moved by whole pixels. Bodies on limp revolute joints are the fallback.
The lamp hangs on the last segment: `external` joins it to the lamp's bracket.

tiling.about: This picture is the kit once, as a cord of 8 cells. A cord of n cells: cell 0 = the mount cell, cells 1 .. n - 2 = middle cells in the order of install/tunnel/cable.json `tiling` (cycle and start per cable), cell n - 1 = the join cell. Take a cell's pieces from `cells` and put them at the target cell; the joint across a cell boundary is the same limp joint (kind hung, hp 35) at the flex's middle on that boundary.
tiling.loudspeaker: for a loudspeaker the join cell is cable_join_horn (install/tunnel/props): cut it into 4 segments of 8 rows the same way; it has no spare loop
tiling.cord1: cable_one (hook and knot in one cell): the mount cell's plate, hook, feed wire and seg_00 .. seg_02, then the knot

external.note: the knot round the lamp's bracket. On a cable the lamp's `bracket` is NOT anchored (its parts.json says anchor: true for a lamp fixed to matter): see lamp_states/lamp_states.json.
the plate is the anchor: when the matter it is bolted to is carved away, the whole cord falls (lamps.ts: lamp:out cause mount)

verlet.load: the lamp (mass from its own parts.json) hangs on the last point
verlet.note: draw each segment's bitmap at its point, moved by whole pixels, never rotated more than its row shear: the picture stays hard

cut.note: where a joint of the flex parts, the upper end may take the hand-drawn frayed end (cable_cut, its top on the joint) in place of the atlas edge overlay; the spark is centred on its tip
